name: 2D Platformer
description: A side-scrolling platformer from the first jump to a short playable demo: movement with coyote time, a tilemap level, enemies, pickups, a menu and a build.
author: Gamedev Dashboard

goals.title: Player movement feels good
steps: Create the player with Rigidbody 2D and Capsule Collider 2D
Add PlayerInputReader and PlatformerController2D
Tune speed, jump height and gravity scale
Add coyote time and jump buffer
Camera follows the player (Cinemachine Position Composer)

goals.title: First level
steps: Make a tile palette from the tileset
Paint ground and platforms on a Tilemap
Add Tilemap Collider 2D and Composite Collider
Place pickups and a goal flag
Playtest and fix gaps that are too wide

goals.title: Enemies and danger
steps: Enemy walks between two points (Patrol2D)
Touching an enemy hurts (DamageOnTouch + Health)
Spikes and pits reset the player
Stomp an enemy from above

goals.title: Art and sound pass
steps: Player idle, run and jump animations
Background layers
Jump, pickup and hit sounds
Background music loop

goals.title: Menu and build
steps: Start menu with Play and Quit
Pause menu
Volume slider
Windows build and test on another PC

pages.title: Game design
pages.markdown:
# Pitch
You play Moss, a tiny forest spirit who jumps through broken ruins to bring the light back to the valley.

## Core loop
- Run and jump through a level
- Collect light seeds
- Reach the shrine at the end

## Controls
- Move: A/D or left stick
- Jump: Space or south button

## Scope for the demo
- [ ] 1 level, about 2 minutes long
- [ ] 1 enemy type (slow beetle)
- [ ] 1 collectible (light seed)

> Keep the first version tiny. Make it fun before you make it big.

pages.title: Level ideas
pages.markdown:
## Level 1: Teach the jump
- Flat start, one small gap
- A higher platform with a pickup above it
- First enemy where it can be avoided

## Level 2: Mix it
- Moving platforms
- Enemies near gaps

---
Write every new idea here first and only build the best ones.
